FlowPocket is a macOS utility for independent researchers. It collects notes and links into local project folders. It works offline and keeps files on the Mac. There is no account, team sync, mobile app, subscription, or AI feature. Minimum platform: macOS 14.
Approved headline: Keep your research within reach.
Approved supporting copy: Collect notes and links into local project folders. Work offline, without an account.
Primary CTA: See the workflow, linking to #how-it-works on this page. The workflow explains Capture a note, Add a link, Return to your project.
Secondary CTA: Email us, linking to mailto:hello@flowpocket.example. This synthetic address must not be contacted.
